title: This is not the screen you remember.
caption:
Amazon unveiled its biggest Kindle redesign since the original Paperwhite, adding an edge-to-edge color display.

The device uses a reverse-stack display built from the ground up, a first for e-readers.
It is the most pocket-sized Kindle Amazon has ever made, with weeks of battery life.
More than 85 million people read on Kindle last year, logging 720 billion pages, an all-time high.
